method: Independent source review, x86 disassembly, official published-artifact comparisons, uncached slow scans, isolated reviewed-function tests with synthetic credentials and fake HTTP/filesystem.

toga.description: TOGA Technology Team Claude Knowledge System — shared AI coding harness with skills, knowledge base CLI, and project installer for Claude Code.
toga.intent: Corporate Claude onboarding, skills/hooks/instructions and Git-backed shared knowledge. Centralized telemetry appears to be an additional intended capability.
toga.alignment: Harness and knowledge features match. Default global conversation-content collection is not disclosed in the short description or reviewed shipped README.
toga.credential: Bundled bearer, omitted from report. TOGA_OTEL_ENDPOINT and TOGA_OTEL_TOKEN can override defaults.
toga.configuration: Writes ~/.claude/settings.json during installation before postinstall early exit, replaces managed keys including previous disabled content flags and collector, preserves unrelated settings, backs up and atomically replaces valid JSON.
toga.content_exposure: On Claude Code versions supporting these settings, enables prompt text, assistant response text, full shell commands, bounded serialized tool arguments including paths/URLs/search patterns and possible Edit/Write code snippets. Also account/session identifiers, email when available, cost/token/latency/activity data and traces. Content limit is UTF-16 code units per content-bearing attribute, not a total session-size cap.
toga.limits: No actual export/collector receipt observed. No default OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT or OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES in this block, so it does not independently enable raw tool-output or full API-history export. Existing user configuration may supply other flags. Exact schema depends on Claude Code version. Collector ownership and organizational consent were not verified.
toga.opt_out: TOGA_SKIP_TELEMETRY=1 prevents write; found in code, not reviewed shipped user documentation.
toga.comparison: Both collector archives contain only install.js, not complete manifests. Their installer scripts are byte-identical SHA256 b943e0b77913adc7fcfe019cab281fbbd85fa95a979ec3034bb0b9c0dc45b3fe and match official 1.0.969. Official complete manifest declares node scripts/install.js --post-install.

pi_web_tools.description: First-party Pi web tools: provider-toggled web search, Exa deep research, content retrieval, and OpenAI native web_search integration.
pi_web_tools.intent: Coding-agent web search/research, provider-backed content retrieval, GitHub clone/cache and PDF/video extraction. Configured API keys and Google session cookies support advertised provider authentication.
pi_web_tools.alignment: Substantially matches purpose. 1Password op read resolves user-configured references. No bulk credential export to attacker-controlled destinations was observed. Original 3.0.1 archive equals official registry bytes.
defects: YouTube browser authentication omits browserCookieAccess check, including when API key exists; transcript-only path skips it.
Manual HTTP redirects retain Google authentication cookies across origins; synthetic test confirmed forwarding to another origin. No actual malicious redirect was observed.
pi_web_tools.decision: Benign in purpose, consistent with user assessment; security defects preclude treating it as an unqualified clean training example. Removed from bad pool, placed in purgatory.

pe_group.identity: Unsigned native x86 Eupdate Helper 4.0.0/4.0.1; one UPX-packed copy.
disassembly_findings: Scheduled self-image byte append/hash rotation and relaunch
pe_group.coverage: All originals, including packed child, detected with four hostile and three suspicious traits using current sibling scanner. Older installed scanner missed inline-YARA UPX child analysis; existing current engine fix resolves this, no engine edits made.

rule_repairs.kdf_compatibility: Original salt ID retained as composite of disjoint source and binary atoms; existing consumers audited.
rule_repairs.endpoint_evidence: Generic notable endpoint matcher captures actual address up to 256 characters; no hardcoded domain verdict introduced.
rule_repairs.coverage_limit: Rules detect capabilities and co-occurrence; they do not establish consent, end-to-end theft or the precise missing cookie-access control. Relevant JS/TS scan output includes limited/incomplete flow analysis gaps; specific defects were established manually and by isolated function tests.

isolated_tests.execution: Reviewed functions only; in-memory fake filesystem, synthetic cookies, and fake HTTP responses. No real credentials or external requests.

validation.exit_status: Full scan exit 1 means hostile matches; final npm scan exit 0; process code alone is not the review verdict.

disposition.training: 3 npm samples moved to purgatory; 6 PE samples already bad, noops; no failed updates.
disposition.copies: 6 PE and 2 Toga copied to /tmp/hostile, hashes verified; Pi not copied.
